scenes.summary: You meet Sergio Leon at the Hub Base. She's buzzing with excitement and invites you to check out her adaptation of real-life events, titled "Umbral Monument".

lines.text: Endmin! I'm so glad you came! I'm Sergio Leon from logistics.
I invited every Endfielder but I never expected that you'll be the first to respond, Endmin! I've completed my first series, the Umbral Monument!
Ah, let me give you a quick intro. I come from a family of filmmakers. Before joining Endfield, I was a director myself.
My parents, grandparents, great-grandparents, even great-great-grandparents were all famous directors. You could easily spot their names in Wrankwood as far back as the Age of Terra...
But they only produced commercial flicks for base entertainment. None of their works depicted the true glory of heroes who faced suffering without fear!
Unlike heroic depictions that cater to mass entertainment, I admire the strength that springs from truth, and the courage born of real life-and-death struggles!
That's why I gathered real-life experiences from field operators to film my movies.
I felt the somber weight of every battle actually fought.
A heroic film deserves a heroic audience, and none is more fitting than you, Endmin!
So please, if you have a moment, how about an immersive dive of my first series, Umbral Monument, adapted from the real-life experiences of our field operators!
*Sigh* Guess one person's imagination can only go so far... I need more stories and materials!
Ugh, I'm worried my previous Umbral Monument wasn't "striking" enough!
When compared to the actual achievements of true heroes, my work is still missing the mark! It's got to hit at our emotions!
I must push myself harder! I must create a true epic to laud the dauntless souls who once walked amongst us!
Farewell for now, Endmin! I'll be back with my new work!
Endmin! Come and check out my latest Umbral Monument!
Even a brand-new work deserves the most discerning of critiques, and no one is more fitting than you, Endmin!
I now have the materials that can finally bring justice for the heroes, and I hope they can be properly evaluated.
Endmin, how do you feel about your immersive experience of the Umbral Monument?
This is definitely gonna be a classic if we include every operator's experience in this work!
